ways.name: Graphify
ways.takes: Install the CLI and register the skill with `uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install`, then run `/graphify .` on a folder of code or notes; it writes graph.html, GRAPH_REPORT.md and graph.json, and `python -m graphify.serve graphify-out/graph.json` serves the graph over MCP.
ways.seen: 2026-10-08 (README; PyPI package graphifyy, no version shown; a hosted platform also exists)

ways.name: Obsidian (CLI + kepano/obsidian-skills)
ways.takes: Turn on Settings > General > Command line interface in Obsidian 1.12.7+, then `/plugin marketplace add kepano/obsidian-skills` and `/plugin install obsidian@obsidian-skills`; the agent uses `obsidian backlinks`, `links`, `orphans` and `search` on [[wikilinked]] notes.

ways.name: Graphify Obsidian export
ways.takes: Run graphify with `--obsidian` (or `--obsidian-dir <vault>`) to write the extracted graph into an Obsidian vault without touching existing notes.

ways.takes: `uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent` then `serena init`, and add it to Claude Code per its client docs: symbol-level code search and editing via language servers, as an MCP server.
